articles.title: ENHYPEN’s “THE SIN : VANISH” Spends 10th Week On Billboard 200 + Remains In Top 10 Of Album Sales Chart
articles.description: ENHYPEN’s latest mini album is a stable hit on the Billboard 200! Back in January, ENHYPEN’s “THE SIN : VANISH” debuted at No. 2 on Billboard’s Top 200 Albums chart, tying the group’s personal record for their highest-ranking album to date. articles.summary: ENHYPEN's mini album "THE SIN : VANISH" has spent its 10th consecutive week on the Billboard 200 chart and remains in the top 10 of the album sales chart. The album debuted at No. 2 in January, tying the group's personal record for highest-ranking album.
articles.author: E Cha
